journey.name: wear quickpay over limit holds
journey.description:
With QuickPay on in the phone's settings, an invoice above the phone's QuickPay amount still opens the review and is paid only by the hold. Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition, in this order, as quickpay-skips-hold.xml: Private settings wallet, never the public test phrase alone, restored on the watch on the local ./spark stack and funded there with at least 12 000 sats before any phone setting changed (journeys/wear/README.md › Private settings wallet, step 5). Then Phone settings on VSS, see README › Phone settings on VSS, with Default Unit Bitcoin, Denomination Modern, Local Currency USD and QuickPay on at $1 and 5×, and the phone app closed. Watch: the app open on the Balance page and the loading ring stopped. The fiat value below is in dollars, which is what those units give. 10 000 sats are above $1 while a bitcoin costs more than $10 000. README › Holding to pay has the hold gesture.

actions.action: Swipe left three times to the Settings page (README › Watch gestures)
Wait up to 15 s until `adb logcat -d -s BitkitWear` lists "Imported the phone's settings"
Swipe right three times to the Balance page
Wait up to 1 minute until "WatchHomeBalanceSecondary" reads a fiat value: without the rates QuickPay holds whatever the amount
Run `../bitkit-docker/spark invoice 10000` and note the BOLT11 invoice it prints as <invoice>
Run `adb shell am start -a android.intent.action.VIEW -d "lightning:<invoice>" to.bitkit.dev`
Wait up to 10 s until "WatchSendHold" is listed
Verify "WatchSendSent" does not get listed within 5 s: nothing was paid
Hold "WatchSendHold" for 2 s as in README › Holding to pay
Wait up to 15 s until "WatchSendSent" is listed
